name: Home Depot RDC - West Columbia SC

fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard-booth checkpoint structure found at any road-edge entrance across zoom 19-20 satellite and Street View (2023-08). Building sits well back inside a logistics park behind retention ponds and grass buffers; truck access is via uncontrolled internal park roads. A web listing cites 'entrance security and strict appointments' — interpreted as appointment-based dock scheduling and a security desk at the building dock office rather than a physical road gate. Marked medium-confidence; the office/check-in area was partly obscured by ponds in available imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone staffed booth structure visible at any entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because no controlled physical truck gate was observed.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows along both long faces, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run along both long faces (N and S) — two distinct dock banks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~130 doors estimated across both long faces; large cross-dock RDC.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved truck yard with abundant unused width for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound; no painted lane control, count approximate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Logistics park in the Saxe Gotha / Southport area of West Columbia with surrounding woodland and a residential edge; Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.geocode: Roster geocode had a 3918 m offset flag; verified pin lands on the correct HD RDC building.
